scope: Production frontend with explicitly simulated same-origin APIs. Fictional documents, projects and chat; no provider/backend extraction or LLM integration qualified here. Root verifies real API separately.

checks.name: Unsupported file is rejected locally without transfer
Ambiguous upload preserves selected file and offers an explicit retry
Retry uses identical bytes and identifier without duplicate original
Uploaded original appears with document source instead of a fictitious email
Extraction does not automatically accept a dossier fact
Conversation defaults to a question with visible intent choices
Question sends explicit read-only intent without a proposal
Change mode prepares exact project and value without applying
Chat proposal and intent controls fit mobile
Preservation barrier blocks confirmation while document upload is in flight
Failed extraction keeps the original and shows honest analysis failure
Revision conflict keeps proposal visible and never automatically replays confirmation
Lost confirmation response never claims success or automatically repeats the mutation
Explicit confirmation posts the reviewed hash and refreshes actual project state
Applied proposal offers no second mutation control
Action proposal can be abandoned without changing the dossier
Document controls and receipt fit mobile
Public demonstration has no upload input
Reader has no document upload control
Reader cannot enter modification mode
No JavaScript error or external provider request
